analyst_view.overall: Celta (12th) lost 3-0 at Rayo last weekend and 1-2 at home to Union Saint-Gilloise in the Europa League on Thursday, so Claudio Giráldez is under some pressure. He said he will use the same available players as on Thursday, with Borja Iglesias, Miguel Román, Starfelt, Álvaro Núñez and El-Abdellaoui still out. Levante are in the bottom three for the first time since matchday 1 and only Manu Sánchez is definitely missing.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals. Celta without Borja Iglesias and with tired legs lose some threat, but Levante's defence has been leaky and they won 3-2 at Balaídos last season. These roughly cancel out.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.2 corners. Celta usually have most of the ball at home, but a tired side without creative midfielder Miguel Román may produce less pressure. Nothing clearly moves the figure.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.3 cards. Levante need points and Giráldez calls them an awkward, well-organised side, but neither team has a suspension problem, so we stay with the site.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.4 shots. Celta played a full European game on Thursday and are missing two of their main attacking outlets, and Giráldez expects Levante to defend in numbers at times. That points to slightly fewer shots.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.5 shots on target. Without Borja Iglesias, Celta's finishing quality drops, and they looked toothless at Rayo, so we lean a little lower.
